front.title: Scientific Quantity Records with Digest-Bound Numeric Verification

abstract.t: This document defines a JSON representation for scientific quantities (a decimal value, a unit, and an optional measurement uncertainty) and a binding by which a computed quantity names, by cryptographic digest, the exact input quantities, operation and arithmetic rules it was derived with. It also defines a fail-closed procedure by which a verifier recomputes the value, checks the unit relationship and, for one named method, recomputes the uncertainty, and reports a separate verdict for each aspect. A passing result means only that the stated numbers follow from the stated inputs under the stated rules. It does not establish that a measurement was valid, that the inputs are true, or that any scientific conclusion follows.
